decisions.reason: Underground LHD loaders sit squarely in the firm's core mining and tunnelling competence, and only one year after launch there is no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search, so management keeps the product while results are still uncertain.

Underground dump trucks complement the loaders in a common mining fleet offering and share engineering, parts and service resources, so with no reported underperformance the firm keeps building the product line rather than dropping it early.
